headline: TSMC raises 2026 sales growth forecast to 44%, leaves capex unchanged - Focus Taiwan
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. said it raised its 2026 sales growth forecast to 44 percent in US dollar terms. It left its capital expenditure budget unchanged.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, producing advanced semiconductors for firms such as Apple and Nvidia, so its outlook is a bellwether for the AI and chip supply chain.

impacts.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
impacts.why: Raised full-year sales growth guidance directly lifts the company's revenue outlook.
